classes.name: GovernedActionLifecycleModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned module that resolves action policy, coordinates budget and blast-radius limits, binds policy attestations, and commits generic approval hold, approve, and deny transitions with audit evidence.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates callers, enforces tenant, namespace, marking, purpose, and capability preflight, and maps protocol messages and errors around Sekai domain modules.

classes.name: GovernedActionApproval
classes.description: Durable pending or terminal decision record that binds the proposing actor, exact action parameters, policy scope, risk class, target, work unit, and deciding principal.

relations.name: delegates_governed_action_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates policy, resource metering, attestation, and generic approval transition behavior to the governed action lifecycle module.

relations.name: governs_action_approval
relations.description: The governed action lifecycle module creates and resolves durable governed action approval records while preserving audit evidence and terminal-state protection.
